description: handle_space_join serializes members with serde_json::to_value(m).unwrap_or_else(|e| json!({'type':'serverFail',...})). If any SpaceMember fails to serialize, the garbage object is added to the members array and written back to the Space. Trigger: backend returns a SpaceMember whose Serialize impl fails (rare but possible if types change). Fix: return Err(JmapError::server_fail) if any member fails to serialize, instead of inserting a sentinel value.
title: space.rs members serialization failure stored as garbage member
